name: Simforea
desc:
Simforea is an island in the [Voidsea](location:voidsea). It is a Driftland that has recently come back from the Voidsea into the far edges of the [Eastern Luminant](location:luminants). It's a (largely) abandoned island with abundant growths of grey vegetation and huge bells scattered around.

In the Old World, Simforea was the site of experimentation that resulted in the creation of a soul-based concoction. Simforea eventually fell to ruin, taking its founder and the Anansi with it in the [Voidsea](location:voidsea). [Knell](entity:knell_the_lunatic_resonator) was the only survivor, left alone with his ever deteriorating sanity.

Simforea eventually got close to the Eastern Luminant, piquing the interest of [The Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority)'s [Peipre](entity:peipre), as well as [The Ministry](faction:the_ministry).
additional_info:
-   Simforea likely derives from the word sinfonia, the Italian word for symphony.
-   Many pieces of text on the island are written in Gatherhand, a writing system used to transcribe the common language in the world of Deepwoken.
